No new agent model run was performed.

entries.name: ASR session collector
entries.liveTestNotes: Current CLI file-event and polling checks passed with synthetic sources, new sessions, restart, exact digests and zero validation errors. Current receipt regressions cover repeated failures, changed and reverted source versions, named sessions and recovery. Real-history and MinIO evidence predates these changes and was not rerun. Production S3, GCS and Azure services were not used.
entries.notes: Incremental session groups for every registered converter, companion and WAL change detection, persistent retry IDs and version-deduplicated failure receipts. Whole-scan failure IDs bind error categories to scan inputs across retries and restarts. Local and S3-compatible targets, GCS and Azure adapters, exact files and receipt manifests.

entries.name: ASR container end-to-end test
entries.notes: Optional clean-container installation, three compatible endpoint agent sessions, plugin capture, native conversion, MinIO collection, headless viewer and OpenTelemetry, Parquet, DuckDB and search export checks. Endpoint URLs and model names are explicit arguments or environment variables. Offline tests check private settings, escaping and endpoint selection.
entries.liveTestNotes: Prior revision: Clean-container live run passed with Claude Code 2.1.305, Codex 0.163.0 and Pi 1.3.0 through the compatible endpoint. Three plugins, three exact MinIO objects, receipt manifests, a 92-record headless viewer check and all three exporters passed. ASR validation had zero errors. Vendor records and one unnamed call produce documented warnings. Aggregate evidence is in tests/e2e/live-test.json. A live run of the current implementation has not been verified.

entries.name: ASR reference collection receiver
entries.liveTestNotes: Current loopback HTTP integration tests cover uploader and machine binding, exact bytes, retries, size limits, unreadable uploads, named failure receipts, session reference validation and manifest validation. A standalone deployed receiver was not exercised.
entries.notes: Private content-addressed storage, linked per-machine receipt windows, original producer method, replacement digests and identity mismatch review.

entries.name: ASR redactor
entries.notes: Offline derived-file redaction with exact source digest, JSON pointer selectors and known secret patterns. Selected values mask every copy in the same record regardless of length, including tool input, metadata and patch lines. Propagation to other records requires substantial text and a unique call. Declares redacted_content and validates before file creation.

entries.name: ASR Git line blame
entries.liveTestNotes: Offline native Claude Code and Codex regressions cover the third and fourth rechecks. A bounded private replay uses 51 edits from 9 sessions, including 40 without original contents. It gives 79 correct lines, 79 unknown and zero wrong. Synthetic generator results and private replay counts are in crates/asr-cli/blame-test.json. No model requests.
entries.notes: Separate edit and commit evidence with prompt, model and approval citations. Exact replay from the Git parent must explain each complete change hunk. Git author dates bound edits. First recorded views and store-wide removal checks constrain credit without trusting independent clocks. Missing evidence stays unknown. Seeded CI exercises at least 2,000 interleaved histories.

entries.name: ASR model step replay
entries.liveTestNotes: The current cutoff and reasoning changes passed loopback HTTP request-capture tests, including the committed Codex sample with unlinked outputs. The proxy model runs in crates/asr-cli/live-test.json predate these changes and were not rerun.
entries.notes: Explicit private provider settings, reconstructed context, prompt and setting variants, copied-history credit, inclusive usage and one session per invocation. Unlinked outputs declare replay_unlinked_outputs. Masked response content declares redacted_content. No tool execution. Fork sandboxes and full agent reruns are outside this command.
